# Hexogonal Transformation
```{r}
# --- 1. SPATIAL SETUP ---
nyc_boundary <- counties("NY", cb = TRUE) %>%
  filter(NAME %in% c("New York", "Kings", "Queens", "Bronx", "Richmond")) %>% 
  st_transform(2263)

# --- 2. POINT FILTERING & PROJECTION ---
collisions <- MotorCollisions %>%
  # Use mdy() for robust date parsing; filter to the 'Modern NYC' baseline
  mutate(date = mdy(`CRASH DATE`)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(LATITUDE), 
         !is.na(LONGITUDE), 
         date >= as.Date("2022-01-01"),
         date <= as.Date("2025-03-22")) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(2263) %>%
  st_filter(nyc_boundary)

# --- 3. HEX GRID GENERATION ---
hex_grid <- st_make_grid(nyc_boundary, cellsize = 1640, square = FALSE) %>%
  st_sf() %>%
  mutate(hex_id = row_number()) %>%
  .[nyc_boundary, ]

# --- 4. SPATIAL JOIN & BOROUGH RECOVERY ---
collisions_clean <- collisions %>%
  st_join(nyc_boundary %>% select(TRUE_BOROUGH = NAME)) %>%
  st_join(hex_grid) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    BOROUGH = coalesce(BOROUGH, toupper(TRUE_BOROUGH)),
    # Floor to week to match the panel structure
    week = floor_date(date, "week")
  )

# --- 5. PANEL AGGREGATION & ZERO FILLING ---
# CRITICAL: Start the sequence at 2022-01-01 to match your filter
final_model_data <- collisions_clean %>%
  group_by(hex_id, week) %>%
  summarise(y_count = n(), 
            injuries = sum(`NUMBER OF PERSONS INJURED`, na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(hex_id = hex_grid$hex_id, 
           week = seq.Date(as.Date("2022-01-01"), as.Date("2026-03-31"), by = "week"),
           fill = list(y_count = 0, injuries = 0))

# --- 6. LLCF FEATURE GENERATION ---
# NOTE: 217,000 is the approximate Northing (Y) for 60th St in EPSG:2263
hex_features <- st_centroid(hex_grid) %>%
  mutate(
    y_coord = st_coordinates(.)[,2],
    dist_60th = abs(y_coord - 217000), 
    is_manh = as.numeric(st_intersects(., nyc_boundary %>% filter(NAME == "New York"), sparse = FALSE)),
    in_zone = if_else(is_manh == 1 & y_coord < 217000, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# --- 7. RECALCULATE BASELINE RISK (2022-2024 ONLY) ---
baseline <- final_model_data %>%
  filter(week < as.Date("2025-01-05")) %>%
  group_by(hex_id) %>%
  summarise(baseline_risk = mean(y_count), .groups = "drop")

# --- 8. FINAL JOIN ---
final_model_data <- final_model_data %>%
  left_join(hex_features, by = "hex_id") %>%
  left_join(baseline, by = "hex_id") %>%
  mutate(
    post = as.numeric(week >= as.Date("2025-01-05")),
    treatment = in_zone * post
  )

final_model_data <- final_model_data %>%
  mutate(week_index = as.numeric(week - min(week)) / 7)

write_csv(final_model_data, "../../data/cleaned/model_data_final.csv")
```
